items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: George Gerard and Pete Fonten and the Santo Brothers, they all really was out there. Bill Shea. Bill Shea. Yeah, right.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well, I remember I came down here one New Year's Eve and you had no trombone.

Yeah, well, I never used a trombone out there until, uh, later years when the money wasn't very big, you know. Yeah. You couldn't afford to get out of a trombone player. So, people would get together, friends, and would, you know, make up Jim's salary. And that's how Jim would come in there. But, uh, hardly ever needed any extra men because always had a bunch of the young white boys would be out there. George Gerard and Pete Fonten and the Santo Brothers, they all really was out there.
